In the heart of the neighborhood, a small but beloved community gathering place has been transformed into a cozy, warm space with the addition of a peat stove. The gable of the building, once a simple roofline, now stands proudly as the foundation for this new heating system. The peat is carefully stacked in a neat, elevated pile, ensuring even heat distribution and a clean, rustic look that complements the surrounding architecture.

The stove, with its elegant design, sits at the center of the room, and the surrounding walls are adorned with wooden spindles that add a touch of traditional charm. The combination of the gable and the spindles creates a harmonious blend of functionality and beauty, making the space both practical and inviting. This project not only brings warmth to the home but also strengthens the bonds of the community, as neighbors gather to share stories and enjoy the gentle crackle of the peat fire.
